numbers.title: Numbers to validate
numbers.description: One number per line. Messy lines are fine: tel: links, labels such as Phone or Tel, (0) trunk prefixes, 00 international prefixes, spaces, dashes, dots, slashes, full-width and Arabic-Indic digits, extensions (ext, x, #, dob). Up to 10,000 lines per run.

text.title: Or paste a list (optional)
text.description: Used only when 'Numbers to validate' is empty. One number per line; a pasted column from a spreadsheet works too.

defaultCountry.title: Default country for local numbers (ISO-2, optional)
defaultCountry.description: Two letters such as UA, US, GB, DE. Needed only for numbers written without a country code (for example 044 123 45 67). Empty means auto: only numbers with a country code are read, the rest come back with a reason instead of a guess.
